description:
Delete pytest-ci.ini and tox.ini, and trim the scripts left unused by dlv2-44. Delete .github/path-filters.yml only after its job is merged into .github/ci-units.yml: ci.yml:156 and :261 still read it through scripts/path_filter_decision.py:17, so it is not yet replaced. Either drop it from the delete list or add an explicit step that moves its rules into ci-units.yml and changes path_filter_decision.py. Trim pytest.ini markers to tier markers plus engine/benchmark selection markers still used; keep .importlinter, codecov.yml, .pre-commit-config.yaml (trimmed).

Each file has live references that this item must change in the same PR:
- pytest-ci.ini: used by the Makefile targets at Makefile:333-370 (they pass `-c pytest-ci.ini`). Point them at pytest.ini or another kept config, or keep the file.
- tox.ini: referenced by .github/ci-units.yml:18, scripts/canary_impact.py (lines 92 and 133, which also lists pytest-ci.ini), scripts/publication/verify_lane_isolation.py:109 and docs/development/dependency-inventory.md (lines 52 and 184).
- path-filters.yml: referenced by ci.yml:156 and :261 via scripts/path_filter_decision.py:17.
